scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:skills && npm run setup:gcloud
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run test -w packages/shared" "npm run test -w apps/server" "npm run test -w apps/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/server && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck:strict: npm run typecheck:strict -w apps/server && npm run typecheck:strict -w apps/web
scripts.precommit: npm run format:affected && npm run check:affected
scripts.check: npm run verify:deps && npm run verify:agent-infra && npm run verify:boundaries && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run verify:doc-paths
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.check:wire: npm run verify:doc-paths && npm run test:wire -w packages/shared && npm run test:wire -w apps/server && npm run test:wire -w apps/web
scripts.verify:boundaries:graph: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --no-progress --output-type dot apps packages | dot -Tsvg -o docs/architecture/dep-graph.svg
scripts.verify:modularity: node -e "console.log('Run /modularity:review in a Claude Code session, or read .cursor/skills/modularity/review/SKILL.md in Cursor. See docs/agents/modularity.md.')"
